Thanks again for the time today. Per our handoff checklist, I want to align on the minimal items we need to get SunriseHealth's production workspace live and seeded so your engineers can start integration tests next week. Proposed starter checklist below (happy to adjust):

- Confirm admin SSO domain and SAML metadata (IdP)
- Provide list of initial admins (name + email + role) for role seeding
- Decide whether you want a separate staging workspace (recommended)
- Confirm API key rotation window and KMS/HSM requirement (if any)

I attached the MRA we signed (sunrise_mra_signed.pdf) and our seed script that Ben will run once we have admin access. Can you share: the domain for SSO, and the email addresses of the three admins you want created?

Proposed onboarding call: Thursday 11/12 10:00 PT — Ben and Karthik will run through the keying and seeding steps. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Hey team —

Quick technical note on seeding and API keys so the Thursday call can be focused:

1) We'll create two workspaces: sunrise-staging and sunrise-prod.
2) Staging will get a scoped API key suitable for smoke tests (no production data). Production keys will be created post-SAML admin verification.
3) Role seed: we prefer to seed these roles by CSV import (roles_matrix.csv) — please confirm the titles you want mapped to Redwood roles (Org Admin, Project Admin, Developer, Read-only).
4) Key lifecycle: default rotation window 90 days; we can shorten to 30 days if you require. If you want KMS-backed keys, we'll need an IAM cross-account role for Redwood to encrypt/decrypt with your KMS CMK.

I've attached a small shell script (seed-script.sh) that automates project creation and initial API key generation in a dry-run mode. On the call we'll run it against staging once Elena confirms her SAML/IdP.

(attachment: seed-script.sh, attachment: roles_matrix.csv)

—Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood
